findings.note: Starter change: the Rays are starting Nick Martinez in Game 1 against Jacob Misiorowski instead of their ace, Drew Rasmussen. Some previews and lines assumed Rasmussen would start. Martinez had a 2.38 ERA on the road and held the Brewers to two runs over six innings in March.

SportsLine's model preview, written when Rasmussen was still the expected starter, cites Over trends: Over 19-13-1 in Rasmussen starts and Over 18-13-3 in Rays games with a total under 7. It also projects multiple total bases for the Rays' top three hitters.

ESPN's preview expects elite run prevention from both teams and low-scoring, close games. It points to the Brewers' bullpen (best among playoff teams), the Rays' rotation, the Rays' low walk rate and the Rays' weak hitting against 98+ mph fastballs.
